{{Quote|My grandfather was married to my grandmother.''"<br />"''Yes, but Corellian Jedi are well&hellip;Corellian&hellip;|Corran Horn and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="union1">[[Union 1|''Union'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Scerra Horn''' was the wife of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nejaa Halcyon]]. She was the mother of [[Hal Horn|Valin Halcyon]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her first husband and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Scerra married her husband's friend [[Rostek Horn]] and had her son's name changed to Valin Horn (nicknamed "Hal"), all in an effort to protect the family from the [[Great Jedi Purge]]. Scerra's grandson&mdash;who became a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] inspector like his father and a Jedi like his biological grandfather&mdash;was [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].<ref name="I, Jedi" />
